description: Public metadata: the official site of the channel, the stream URL to copy into another player, and the legacy HTTP player. The legacy_url button opens http://legacy.gradetv.net/legacy?stream=ID, with no port in the address. The standalone page accepts lang=pt/en/es/fr/de/hu and theme=light/dark. Playlists go through the HTTPS hop, and the media comes directly from the origin. It does not remove an access refusal or a CORS requirement. It is one indexed read: it does not fetch the origin and does not write to the database.
